lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively equidistant across the ribcage, with the anterior-most line significantly shorter than the subsequent segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior-most line is a truncated segment terminating mid-torso; the third line from the anterior shows a visible break/thinning in the upper third of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Sparse clustering of approximately 4-5 distinct white circular spots located on the dark fur region immediately superior and posterior to the white hind-limb patch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Symmetrical lyrate curvature; horns emerge vertically, curve laterally-posteriorly, and then recurve medially towards the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel distance between horn tips is 1.8 times the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12 percent of the total horn length at the distal ends consists of high-contrast ivory-colored tips.

other_distinctive_markers: White transverse chevron between the eyes; prominent white dorsal mane of hair extending the length of the spine; single high-contrast white spot on the lower cheek.
